name: Cơm lam
summary: Bamboo-tube rice with sesame salt. The sweetness is attributed to upstream water, and the smell to young bamboo.
origin: Bamboo-tube rice on the Langbiang side of Da Lat and in Cu Lan village.
howToEat: Eat the tube with sesame salt, and with grilled forest meat, grilled chicken, and grilled eggs.
The sweetness is attributed to upstream water, and the smell to young bamboo.
where: Toward Langbiang, or in Cu Lan village.
seoDescription: Bamboo-tube rice with sesame salt. The sweetness is attributed to upstream water, and the smell to young bamboo.
